fks.definition: FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES fitmatch_catalog.products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (mapping_release_id) REFERENCES fitmatch_catalog.releases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES fitmatch_vnext.products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (product_variant_id) REFERENCES fitmatch_vnext.product_variants(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (product_size_id) REFERENCES fitmatch_vnext.product_sizes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (garment_type_code) REFERENCES fitmatch_vnext.garment_types(garment_type_code) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (source_code_snapshot) REFERENCES fitmatch_vnext.sources(source_code) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

views.name: current_product_classifications
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.source,
    p.external_product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.canonical_url,
    p.audience,
    p.source_category_path,
    p.source_category_codes,
    p.image_url,
    p.input_fingerprint,
    p.lifecycle_status,
    p.last_seen_at,
    h.id AS classification_id,
    h.category_code,
    h.detail_code,
    h.comparison_family_code,
    h.length_code,
    h.classification_status,
    h.classification_method,
    h.confidence,
    h.requires_user_confirmation,
    h.taxonomy_policy_version,
    h.mapping_release_id,
    h.decision_version,
    h.evidence
   FROM (fitmatch_catalog.products p
     LEFT JOIN fitmatch_catalog.product_classification_history h ON (((h.product_id = p.id) AND h.is_current)));

limitations: Text-based callers do not prove absence of dynamic SQL or external clients. No deletion or post-deletion runtime test.
